title: Version 3.11: Side Chats and Conversation Search
description: Cursor 3.11 introduces side chats that run alongside your main chat for parallel AI conversations, conversation search for agent transcripts with Cmd+K and Cmd+F, redesigned project and repo pickers, new cloud agent hooks for observing and controlling agent conversations, MCPs and Organizations in Team Marketplaces, Cursor Mobile App for iOS with cloud agents and remote control, unified Customize page, and enhanced Cursor Automations with /automate skill and new GitHub/Slack triggers.

community_feedback.quote: I like working in jetbrains more than in a cursor but the power that cursor gives is something you can't miss in 2026
Cursor is no longer primarily about writing code

title: In-app browser on Desktop
description: Claude Code on desktop gets a built-in browser, so Claude can pull up docs, designs, or any other site and interact with pages the same way it does with local dev server previews. Also includes /doctor command for full setup diagnostics that can fix issues, auto mode blocks transcript tampering and asks before rm -rf on unresolved variables, and agent view rows show colored state word and classifier-written headline.

community_feedback.quote: I've been using Claude Code and honestly, I'm amazed every time

title: Copilot App Available to All
description: The GitHub Copilot app became available on every Copilot plan, supporting macOS, Windows, and Linux platforms, expanding Copilot's accessibility across all major operating systems.

title: Repository Overviews Feature
description: GitHub Copilot launched a new feature giving developers one-click explanations of unfamiliar projects directly from eligible repository home pages, helping developers understand new codebases faster.

title: Copilot Vision generally available
description: GitHub Copilot Vision is now generally available, allowing developers to attach images (JPEG, PNG) and PDFs directly to chat prompts so Copilot can reason about visual content. Browser tools for GitHub Copilot in VS Code are also generally available.

community_feedback.quote: Visual Studio 2026 users reported the copilot experience is horrible with broken markdown rendering
Users expressing frustration that they can't trust it to do proper analysis

title: Auto model selection for enterprises
description: Enterprises can now default to auto model selection, allowing Copilot to intelligently route tasks to the most appropriate AI model based on system health and model performance. Additionally, enterprise managed-settings.json is generally available.

title: Copilot CLI auto model selection
description: Copilot CLI auto model selection now routes based on task type, ensuring optimal model selection for different types of development work. This improvement helps tailor AI assistance to specific coding tasks.

title: Diff Line Permalinks
description: You can now copy links to specific lines in diffs and share them with your team. These permalinks provide direct navigation to the referenced lines. Also includes MCP spec alignment updates and various bug fixes.

title: Desktop Changelog Updates
description: Added 'New session in space' to the session kebab menu, and Devin Cloud sessions now auto-reconnect when the network returns. Fixed issues with diff viewing in autonomous mode and orphaned Devin agent process cleanup on Windows.

title: Version 0.50.0 and 0.51.0-preview
description: Latest stable release v0.50.0 and preview release v0.51.0-preview.0 (July 8, 2026) with experimental features. Nightly build v0.52.0-nightly (July 13, 2026) also available.

title: July 2026 Updates
description: Codex releases new usage-credit controls, expanded app approval and authentication flows, safer Ultra reasoning warnings, and various bug fixes. Previous updates included GPT-5.5 integration, Goal mode going stable, Sites feature, Chrome extension, and Amazon Bedrock support.

title: Dev Mode and Teams Mode
description: Version 1.10 update (July 26) added dev mode and teams mode, featuring better models, better context, and more control over chat experience. The product continues to evolve with enhanced SWE-1.5 model integration and improved components.
